author: steven5703
body:
Hey guys, I've been noticing the amount of AMAs on the forums..... it's becoming really, really,REALLY spammy. I feel every other topic is an AMA.



Solution: Add an AMA category that's hidden from recent discussions. All AMAs must be posted in this subforum or else it'll get moved there.

This was recreated because of the terrible amount of spam on the other topic. 
I'm getting you forum banned if you do that again.

replies.author: FallTimeSummer
replies.body:
I'm going to say this: 
First of all, this honestly isn't important, nor is it fair. The AMAs are created to be seen, not to be hidden away. Why don't we just get rid of the entire Recent Discussions page if we do this, because I don't always want to see all the build team stuff and the maps and the YouTube requests/videos. But do you see me complaining?
Secondly, I got carried away. If you'd actually told me to stop, I would've.
POINT PROVEN.
